What the website provides

The website offers free printable mandalas, coloring suggestions and PDF downloads for personal and classroom activities. This version has no paid checkout, subscription, account, public comments or user-upload facility. It is not an accredited educational service, and does not offer medical or therapeutic advice.

Hosting

The public website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub documents that visitors’ IP addresses are logged and stored for security, whether or not they are signed in. Read the GitHub General Privacy Statement and our privacy notice for information on data handling.

Creative identity

Patrick is a fictional studio character whose portrait was generated with AI. The project and downloadable collection are real; the character is not presented as evidence of a real person’s qualifications or professional experience. Details of the creative process appear on About the studio.

Legal and intellectual-property enquiries

Contact the operator at the email above. For a rights concern, identify the relevant page or file, the material concerned, your relationship to the rights holder and a way to respond. Do not include unnecessary sensitive data. A report will be reviewed; submitting it does not automatically establish infringement.

Applicable rules

The project is intended to be operated from Spain. Where applicable, the operator’s activities are subject to Spanish rules, including Law 34/2002 on information-society services, EU data-protection law and Spain’s Organic Law 3/2018. Mandatory protections in other jurisdictions remain applicable when their legal conditions are met. These notices do not assert universal legal compliance.
